nodes.label: NestJS starter repository
nodes.rationale: The apps/backend README is the upstream Nest framework TypeScript starter. It documents npm install, npm run start, start:dev, start:prod, unit tests, e2e tests, and coverage. The text does not mention HoneBill, Pijin, Prisma, or the rebuild.

nodes.label: NestJS
nodes.rationale: Progressive Node.js framework for efficient and scalable server-side applications. MIT-licensed open source. The starter points at the GitHub repository nestjs/nest and at https://nestjs.com.

nodes.label: NestJS Mau
nodes.rationale: Official platform named in the starter for deploying NestJS applications on AWS. Install with npm install -g @nestjs/mau and deploy with mau deploy. Documented at https://mau.nestjs.com.

nodes.label: Kamil Myśliwiec
nodes.rationale: Named as the author of Nest. The starter links a personal Twitter account and the Nest website.

nodes.label: NestJS documentation
nodes.rationale: Cited framework docs at https://docs.nestjs.com, plus the deployment guide at https://docs.nestjs.com/deployment. The same resources section also points at Discord, courses, Devtools, enterprise support, and the jobs board.
